headline: Weathered Expanse Rages As Nevish Line Burns Bright
war_summary: Since the noon edition the centre of action has shifted westward, with the Weathered Expanse now filing the heaviest wire at 56 transfers on the day, five in the last two hours to the hour of filing, about Crow's Nest, Shattered Advance and Wightwalk, holding three Warden, one Colonial and five ruined posts on losses of 8,260 Colonial and 8,296 Warden. The Nevish Line follows close with 46 on the day, four in two hours last heard at 1450 about Mistle Shrine, Princefal and the Scrying Belt, on losses of 11,904 Colonial and 14,823 Warden. Callahan's Passage has stirred anew with two in two hours, fourteen on the day about Crumbling Post last at 1406. Linn Mercy counts 37 on the day about Rotdust and Outwich Ranch but none in two hours last at 1210, as Marban Hollow stands likewise silent in two hours with eleven on the day about Checkpoint Bua, and Mooring County quiet in two hours with nineteen on the day about the Wind Hills. Stonecradle remains still since yesterday.
